topic: Youth anti-government protest (Tinubu Must Go) over economic hardship, fuel subsidy removal and bad governance, Potiskum (Yobe State)
scale: hundreds of youths, Potiskum LGA, Yobe State
quote1: Hundreds of youths yesterday staged a peaceful protest in Potiskum Local Government Area of Yobe State, tagged “Tinubu Must Go”, saying President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s Independence Day broadcast did not address their grievances.
quote2: Hundreds of youths, businessmen and women from various political parties in Potiskum Local Government Area of Yobe State have called for the resignation of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu over the removal of the fuel subsidy and the hardship being experienced by ordinary Nigerians.
